description: The player: walks its `fynkel.CharacterController` from the `move` action in the frame of the `fynkel.ThirdPersonCamera` named [cameraName], sprints while `sprint` is held, jumps on the `jump` press while grounded, dies on a `hazard` zone or below [fallY] (respawns at the start), restarts the run on `restart`, and keeps the clock.
